atAGlance: Nước tăng lực is energy drink, sweet, caffeinated, intense, and common at convenience stores and late-night food stops.
whatItIs: Nước tăng lực is a canned or bottled energy drink. Expect energy drink that is sweet, fizzy or syrupy, caffeinated, and intense.
howToEnjoy: Order it cold if you need a quick caffeine hit, but expect sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Order nước tăng lực cold by can or bottle, then decide ice. Ask for no ice or less ice if you do not want it poured over much ice.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese convenience stores and roadside stops, energy drinks are common on late-night food runs; expect sweet caffeine more than subtle flavor.
goodToKnow: Contains caffeine and lots of sugar.
